questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code emits structured log records? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A request arrives with header X-Request-ID: abc123 and IndexBatch fails on the HTTP call. Which fields does the 'bulk request failed' record carry?
choices: Only err and docs, since the call passes just those attributes
request_id, method, path and service from the middleware logger, then index, then err and docs
Only request_id, because the middleware replaces the base logger's attributes
Nothing from the middleware, because logging.From falls back to the default logger

questions.prompt: What happens to the log output when the handler returns a 502 for a request?
choices: Nothing is logged by the middleware, which only logs successful requests
The 'request completed' record is written at Error level with status and elapsed
The record is written at Info level because the default status is 200
The middleware panics because the status code was already written

questions.prompt: Which situation produces a log line and an error return from IndexBatch without any HTTP failure?
choices: The server answers 200 and some items in the response carry a status of 300 or above
The server answers 200 and every item is below 300
The context has a debug logger attached
The batch contains an empty Docs slice and the server answers 200
